post.description: Remotely schedules a batch campaign to run at a given time. My tokens local to the campaign's parent program can be overridden for the run to customize content. When using the "cloneToProgramName" parameter described below, this endpoint is limited to 20 calls per day. Required Permissions: Execute Campaign

parameters.name: campaignId
parameters.description: Id of the batch campaign to schedule.

active.description: Whether the campaign is active. Only applicable to trigger campaigns

createdAt.description: Datetime when the campaign was created

id.description: Unique integer id of the Smart Campaign

programId.description: Id of the parent program if applicable

programName.description: Name of the parent program if applicable

updatedAt.description: Datetime when the campaign was most recently updated

workspaceName.description: Name of the parent workspace if applicable

Campaign.description: Record of a Marketo Smart Campaign

code.description: Error code of the error. See full list of error codes here

message.description: Message describing the cause of the error

errors.description: Array of errors that occurred if the request was unsuccessful

nextPageToken.description: Paging token given if the result set exceeded the allowed batch size

result.description: Array of results for individual records in the operation, may be empty

warnings.description: Array of warnings given for the operation

cloneToProgramName.description: Name of the resulting program. When set, this attribute will cause the campaign, parent program, and all of its assets, to be created with the resulting new name. The parent program will be cloned and the newly created campaign will be scheduled. The resulting program is created underneath the parent. Programs with snippets, push notifications, in-app messages, static lists, reports, and social assets may not be cloned in this way

runAt.description: Datetime to run the campaign at. If unset, the campaign will be run five minutes after the call is made

tokens.description: List of my tokens to replace during the run of the target campaign. The tokens must be available in a parent program or folder to be replaced during the run

ScheduleCampaignRequest.description: Record describe how to schedule the campaign

name.description: Name of the token. Should be formatted as "{{my.name}}"
